_comment: One Datadog monitor per rule in deploy/prometheus/rules/meridian.yml (D-353), applied by deploy/tools/datadog_monitors.py. Recipients are added when applied, from DATADOG_NOTIFY, and are never written here.

monitors.name: Meridian ApiUnavailable: the api's metrics endpoint is not answering
monitors.message:
The api has not answered a scrape for a minute.

See docs/OPERATIONS.md#apiunavailable in the repository.

monitors.name: Meridian DatabaseUnavailable: the api cannot reach the database
monitors.message:
The api reports the database unreachable.

See docs/OPERATIONS.md#databaseunavailable in the repository.

monitors.name: Meridian SchemaMigrationMismatch: the schema is not the one the code expects
monitors.message:
The database schema does not match the running code.

See docs/OPERATIONS.md#schemamigrationmismatch in the repository.

monitors.name: Meridian StationStale: a station's heartbeat is late
